about: Inkling, every tensor in its source dtype from the HF BF16 checkpoint (bf16; the router's selection bias and output scale f32): the BF16 reference container. The routed / shared experts and the dense MLP are split out of the fused w13 tensors by the Source view (inkling.py); the drafter and the hmlp tower are written; model.audio.* is consumed by name. Fits any Inkling checkpoint (the 3-layer mini and Inkling-Small).
